annotations.title: Price every weekend for a city

description: Compare published weekends by price (integer cents) for a tier, a month or the year average, a group and an optional origin. By default (detail cities) one row per city: its cheapest persona, min_total_cents and min_per_person_cents. detail all adds a row per (city, persona) with total, per person, flights and the persona's party_shapes, which city and persona narrow. Estimates only, no fare lookups; cached for a minute per parameter set.

city.description: City slug; keeps only that city's rows.

detail.description: cities (default): one row per city, its cheapest persona. all: also a row per (city, persona).

friday.description: Friday of the weekend, YYYY-MM-DD; echoed, not priced.

month.description: Month of travel, or the twelve-month mean (default).

origin.description: Origin slug; enables flights, travel hours and distance.

persona.description: Persona slug; with detail all, keeps only that persona's rows.
